values: High Command has decided to launch an anti-helicopter sweep across enemy territory. You must pursue and destroy as many helicopters as possible in your sector.  Several areas are well defended so proceed with caution.
The destruction of so many helicopters has made the enemy suspend all flights in the region. Your bravery has hit the headlines.
This successful operation has subdued enemy aerial activity in the region.
Enemy SuperCobras in your sector have inflicted heavy damage upon allied armored formations.  Your failure has resulted in heavy allied casualties.
